normative_constraints: Canonical bytes without LF, no self hash, <=8192 bytes. Pure schema validity is not executable identity.
application_source_sha256 exact sorted git ls-files applications inventory; no missing or additional files. public_module_sha256 exact five PUBLIC paths from pinned original build.py.

backend_source_inventory_sha256 = SHA256(canonical sorted path-to-actual-SHA256 map for all git ls-files backend). Reconstruct inventory from the exact clean checkout; no arbitrary supplied root trusted.
contract_source_sha256 exact six paths specified in CONTRACT-AND-PLAN.md. policy_file_sha256 hashes unchanged approved policy.json file; limit_policy_sha256 hashes canonical policy.json limits map.
Dependencies exactly every name/version in unchanged application requirements.lock; compare actual installed versions and exact lock digest. CPython exact patch version retained.
All path keys repository-relative, unique, no traversal/symlink substitution; map values recomputed from local bytes; dirty/untracked executable trees refuse. Existing source trust exclusions remain.
git_commit and actual source checks both required; commit label alone is insufficient. Historical replay requires byte-equal local and recorded build.
Prepared synthetic build objects must not validate as this executable build or establish passing identity.
